scope_and_limitations: This report records static source evidence only; no build, runtime, model inference, GPU or installation tests were performed by this audit.
UI source hashes bind this report to the inspected working files. Re-run if any of these files change.
connect calls are compared as a multiset because the unchanged input-source block moved earlier in buildWorkbench; all lambda tokens are retained.
setupStyle and build methods were reviewed from the complete diff; palette, CSS, spacing, sizes, decoration properties and displayed heading text are the accepted visual changes.
Packaging/release tooling modifications are outside the inference/UI-operation byte-identity claim and are not classified as unchanged.
No assertion is made about untracked user files/settings being runtime-tested. No user data was opened for modification by this audit.
